category_title: Non-symbolic communicators with quadriplegic cerebral palsy who use facial expressions and physical resistance to express preferences
scenario_title: Play and sensory activity with toys
minimal_context: Tony is participating in a play and sensory activity with a staff member using a storybook and toy animals.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at this storybook together. Look at this page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns away from the book and the staff member.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, let's try something else. Look at this toy snake. (Dances the toy snake in front of him)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns away, his mouth opens wide, eyes close, looking alarmed.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How about the toy tiger instead? (Dances the toy tiger in front of him)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (His hand comes up to ward off the tiger as he screams.)

STUDENT: (His hand comes up to ward off the tiger as he screams.)
